title: Sequencer meridian-flip pause documentation disagrees with forwarded time units
summary: Canonical Sequencer.md describes enable_meridian_flip time as seconds. Sequencer.js forwards it unchanged through set_pause_after_transit to Imager AGENT_IMAGER_BATCH.PAUSE_AFTER_TRANSIT, whose source definition and computation use hours. Nonzero values interpreted as documented can schedule the wrong transit pause. Next action: reconcile the public unit contract, correct reference or conversion as appropriate, and verify with a focused simulator test. Draft guide exposes the discrepancy; no runtime validation or source fix here.
evidence: verification.md, Sequencer transit pause discrepancy; Sequencer.md line307; Sequencer.js enable_meridian_flip and set_pause_after_transit; Imager source definition Pause after transit (h).
